demonstration_policy: Fixed chat examples from the frozen development source. Identical demonstration messages, including their informal arguments, appear in both conditions; only the TARGET informal proof is ablated.
development_measurement: All 30 seeds in both conditions, one attempt per candidate/example/condition, no repair.
selection_exclusion: Exclude the union of all demonstration IDs and their definitional-equivalent development statements from every candidate's selection score.
selection_rule: Maximize raw-format-compliant outputs on the common selection subset, pooled over both conditions.
Then maximize Rocq-verified outputs on that subset.
Then maximize outputs that both verify and match the fixed argument-structure proxy on that subset.
Then prefer fewer demonstrations; then earlier candidate order.
format_definition: Nonempty raw output, trimmed only at its edges, accepted by the existing restricted proof-body parser. Markdown fences fail this metric even if v1-compatible extraction later permits verification.
evaluation_gate: No evaluation examples are loaded by development or selection. Evaluation requires the selected prompt and development evidence to be frozen and checksum-verified first.
